cross_market_insights: All three AU cities return the same weak top 3: a directory small-budget listicle (no date), a 2023 packager cost comparison, and a Pinterest pin. No AU result is a line-by-line destination budget.
London ranks destinationido.com first (planner-quoted contingency of at least 10%), then the same Pinterest pin and a 2019 WeddingWire tips piece.
Every result is dated 2019 to 2025 or undated, and skews to 'on a budget' saving tips. Nobody writes for a high-budget couple (AUD 150K+) or explains what each line covers and what to ask.

SERP features everywhere: AI Overview, forums (Reddit r/DestinationWeddings 'what expenses should be considered', Facebook, Quora), PAA 'How do I break down my wedding budget?' (AU) and 'What is the average budget for a destination wedding?' (UK). Image pack is spreadsheets and templates (destinationweddingdetails.com, The Knot, Brides).
UK related searches 'destination wedding budget calculator' and 'all inclusive destination wedding budget' confirm template and tool intent.
Nobody covers destination-only lines with substance: legal and documents, guest transfers, room-block attrition, currency and payment schedule across currencies, wet-weather plan, planner fee.
payload.recommended_angle: A line-by-line destination wedding budget template for a luxury couple: each line says what it covers, what to ask before you sign, and where our cost guides give real figures, plus the lines only a destination wedding has (legal, transfers, room blocks, currency, wet weather). Built to answer the 'break down my budget' PAA and the template image intent, with Wonderland Studio's budget tracker as the place to keep it.
